name: Deep Galerkin Method (DGM)
summary: Train neural PDE solutions through meshfree residual and boundary-condition losses.
core_idea: Parameterize a PDE solution with a neural network and minimize sampled differential residuals.
innovation: Offers an early high-dimensional neural PDE solver formulation independent of mesh discretization.
limitations: Training and loss-conditioning problems can be severe.
A small empirical residual does not necessarily ensure accurate global solutions.

start_here.why: Early neural residual-based solver precursor/comparator to later PINN terminology.
start_here.focus: PDE residual objective, sampling, and high-dimensional examples.

curation_note: Scholarly source and method contribution checked; starting references are suggestions, not mandatory reading.
